simp_chinese: 卡扎钦斯科耶位于乔尔纳亚河汇入叶尼塞河之处，坐落在贯穿西伯利亚中部的大河通道上。聚落建于1650年，沿着连接叶尼塞河各聚落的道路发展。河畔低洼的草甸使村庄得以接近河水，但春季叶尼塞河上涨时，也会遭受洪水侵袭。

english: Kazachye stands on the lower Yana where the Kazachka enters the river, south of the great delta that opens onto the Laptev Sea. The surrounding lowlands belong to a northern world of tundra and long winter ice. In the seventeenth century Russian expeditions followed the Yana into this country and established winter quarters along its course. The river offered the principal line of communication through a region whose channels and lakes change with the seasons.
simp_chinese: 卡扎奇耶位于亚纳河下游、卡扎奇卡河注入亚纳河之处，在通向拉普捷夫海的广大三角洲以南。四周低地是苔原与漫长冬季冰封的北方世界。十七世纪，俄罗斯探险队沿亚纳河进入这片地区，并在沿岸设立越冬据点。河流成为穿越这片土地的主要交通线，附近的河道与湖泊则随季节而变化。

english: Kazaidi lies near the upper Lualaba, north of the river's descent from the Katanga plateau. Rapids and falls break the Lualaba's course as it drops towards the Upemba Depression. Beyond Bukama the river crosses a chain of marshy lakes, including Upemba and Kisale, on its long journey north.
simp_chinese: 卡扎伊迪靠近卢阿拉巴河上游，位于河流从加丹加高原下降之处以北。卢阿拉巴河流向乌彭巴洼地时，河道被急流和瀑布打断。过了布卡马，它穿过一连串沼泽湖泊，包括乌彭巴湖和基萨莱湖，继续向北远行。

english:
Kazan stands above the Volga near the mouth of the Kazanka, on ground where a Bulgar fortress guarded the middle Volga. It grew as a trading town of the Golden Horde, and a chronicle first mentions it in 1391, when Novgorodian river raiders came down the Volga. In 1438 the deposed Horde khan Ulugh Muhammad seized the town and made it the capital of the Kazan Khanate; a wooden kremlin was built around the Bulgar fort. Wars with Moscow forced the Grand Prince first to pay tribute, but by the end of the fifteenth century Kazan was a Muscovite protectorate. In the 1520s the Giray dynasty of Crimea took power there.

Ivan IV's army stormed Kazan on 2 October 1552, and much of the city was destroyed. Tatars were forbidden to settle within thirty versts, and some seven thousand Russians were brought in to resettle it. In 1556 two hundred Pskov masons under Postnik Yakovlev began the white-stone kremlin, which by 1568 had thirteen towers. The icon of Our Lady of Kazan was found after the fire of 1579. Kazan became a governorate seat in 1708, and in 1758 opened Russia's first provincial gymnasium. Pugachev's rebels burned much of the city in 1774. The Marjani Mosque rose in the 1760s, a university opened in 1804, and by the end of the century about one in ten residents was Tatar.
simp_chinese:
喀山坐落在伏尔加河上方、喀赞卡河口附近，原来有一座保加尔人的要塞守卫着伏尔加河中游。它作为金帐汗国的商业城镇发展起来，1391年编年史首次提到它，当时诺夫哥罗德的河上劫掠者顺伏尔加河而下。1438年，被废黜的金帐汗乌鲁·穆罕默德夺取该城，使之成为喀山汗国的都城；保加尔旧堡周围修起了木质克里姆林。与莫斯科的战争起初迫使莫斯科大公向喀山纳贡，但到十五世纪末，喀山已成为莫斯科的保护国。1520年代，克里米亚的格来王朝在这里掌权。

1552年10月2日，伊凡四世的军队攻克喀山，城市大部被毁。鞑靼人被禁止在三十俄里以内定居，约七千名俄罗斯人被迁入。1556年，二百名普斯科夫石匠在波斯特尼克·雅科夫列夫带领下开始修建白石克里姆林，到1568年建成十三座塔楼。1579年大火之后发现了喀山圣母像。1708年喀山成为省治，1758年开办俄国第一所省级中学。1774年普加乔夫的起义军烧毁了城市大部。马尔贾尼清真寺在1760年代建成，大学于1804年开办，到世纪末，居民中约十分之一是鞑靼人。

english: In the country around the Kazan River, bare outcrops of the ancient Canadian Shield rise above lakes, plains and tundra. Caribou trails cross the land on either side of the river, which cuts through rapids and a red sandstone gorge at Kazan Falls. The valley is part of the homeland of the Caribou Inuit. For centuries, hunters gathered at crossings on the lower river to take migrating herds, securing food and hides for the long winter.
simp_chinese: 卡赞河一带，古老加拿大地盾的岩石裸露在湖泊、平原与苔原之上。驯鹿的足迹纵横河流两岸；河水经过急流，在卡赞瀑布流入红砂岩峡谷。这片河谷是驯鹿因纽特人的故地之一。几个世纪以来，猎人们在下游的渡河地点聚集，捕猎迁徙的鹿群，为漫长冬季储备食物和兽皮。

english: Kazari is a village in the Ryazan countryside near the Oka. Its Church of the Dormition appears in seventeenth-century parish records, which also place the neighbouring village of Muromino within its parish. The church served a rural community of estates and villages outside the town of Ryazan. In 1744 the landowner Lev Izmaylov requested repairs to its roof, preserving a small record of the care given to the parish building.
simp_chinese: 卡扎里是梁赞附近奥卡河地区的一座村庄。村中的圣母安息教堂见于17世纪教区文书，邻近的穆罗米诺村也属于该教区。教堂服务于梁赞城外由庄园和村落组成的乡村社群。1744年，地主列夫·伊兹迈洛夫请求修理屋顶，为教区建筑的维护留下了一条记载。

english: Kazatlyk lies near the Karatau Mountains and Lake Bilikol, on the eastern side of the range. The Assa River passes through Bilikol, bringing water from the neighbouring mountains before continuing towards the lower lakes and sands. Bilikol is the largest lake along the Assa, a conspicuous body of water at the edge of the dry Kazakh steppe.
simp_chinese: 卡扎特雷克位于卡拉套山和比利科尔湖附近，在山脉东侧。阿萨河流经比利科尔，将邻近山地的水带入湖中，随后继续流向下游湖泊与沙地。比利科尔是阿萨河沿线最大的湖泊，在干燥的哈萨克草原边缘格外醒目。

english: Kazaure lies north of Kano among hills and cultivated plains in the Hausa country. In the early nineteenth century Ibrahim Dan Tunku, a Fulbe warrior and scholar, established an emirate here during the upheavals associated with the Sokoto jihad. He made a fortified settlement his headquarters, and the new territory was formed from lands adjoining Kano, Katsina and Daura. Kazaure’s ruling house thus emerged from the political changes that reshaped Hausaland after 1804.
simp_chinese: 卡扎乌雷位于卡诺以北，周围是豪萨地区的丘陵与耕作平原。十九世纪初，富尔贝战士兼学者易卜拉欣·丹·通库在索科托圣战引发的变动中建立埃米尔国。他以一处设防聚落为驻地，新领土取自卡诺、卡齐纳和道拉相邻的土地。卡扎乌雷的统治家族因此产生于1804年后重塑豪萨兰的政治变革。

english: Kazeh lies in Unyanyembe, the country of the Nyamwezi in the interior of East Africa. Its name became associated with a well and a village at the site later known as Tabora. Before the growth of the great nineteenth-century caravan settlement, the surrounding countryside was already home to Nyamwezi communities and their chiefs.
simp_chinese: 卡泽位于东非内陆尼亚姆韦齐人的乌尼扬延贝地区。这一名称与一口水井及后来称作塔博拉的村落相联系。十九世纪大型商队聚落兴起以前，周围乡间已有尼亚姆韦齐人的社群及其首领。

english:
Kazembe is the title of a Lunda ruler whose kingdom grew around the lower Luapula and Lake Mweru. The river enters the lake through a broad floodplain, while its outlet, the Luvua, carries the waters towards the Lualaba. The country around the lake became the eastern seat of a ruling house whose origins lay in the Lunda lands farther west.

In the eighteenth century, an ancestor of the Kazembe crossed the Lualaba and established a capital near Lake Mweru. Under Lukwesa Ilunga, who came to power around 1760, the royal seat moved south to Kantapala near the Mofwe lagoon. The ruler appointed Lunda chiefs to administer outlying territories, and Portuguese visitors approached the court from the east before the close of the century.
simp_chinese:
卡曾贝是隆达统治者的称号，其王国在卢阿普拉河下游与姆韦鲁湖周围兴起。卢阿普拉河穿过宽阔的泛滥平原注入湖中，湖水再经卢武阿河流向卢阿拉巴河。环湖地区成为这一王室的东部权力中心，其起源则在更西方的隆达土地。

十八世纪，卡曾贝的一位先祖渡过卢阿拉巴河，在姆韦鲁湖附近建立都城。约1760年即位的卢奎萨·伊隆加将王庭南迁至莫夫韦潟湖附近的坎塔帕拉。他任命隆达首领管理各地，世纪末葡萄牙访客也从东方来到王庭。

english:
Kazerun lies in a warm valley of western Fars, on the road between Shiraz and the Persian Gulf. To its north are the ruins of Bishapur, the Sasanian city founded by Shapur I, and the carved rock reliefs of the Tang-e Chogan gorge. Kazerun grew as the older city declined, becoming a centre of trade and religious life on the route through the mountains to the coast.

The Sufi master Abu Ishaq Kazaruni, who died in 1033, founded a religious community in the town. His lodge and tomb became centres of devotion, and the order bearing his name developed ties with merchants travelling by sea. By the fourteenth century its presence extended to ports in India and southern China, reflecting the reach of merchants based at Kazerun. The poet Mahmud ibn Uthman celebrated Abu Ishaq in works composed at the town's lodge in 1342 and 1343. Kazerun's religious reputation thus travelled far beyond the valley where the order began.
simp_chinese:
卡泽伦位于法尔斯西部温暖谷地，坐落在设拉子与波斯湾之间的道路上。北方是萨珊沙阿沙普尔一世建立的比沙普尔城遗址，以及乔甘峡谷中的岩刻浮雕。随着古城衰落，卡泽伦逐渐兴起，成为穿越山地通往海岸的道路上的贸易和宗教中心。

1033年去世的苏菲导师阿布·易司哈格·卡泽鲁尼在城中建立宗教社群。他的修道院与陵墓成为敬奉中心，以他命名的教团又与海上旅行的商人建立联系。到十四世纪，教团活动延伸至印度和中国南方港口，反映了卡泽伦商人的广泛往来。诗人马哈茂德·伊本·奥斯曼于1342和1343年在当地修道院创作诗篇，赞颂阿布·易司哈格。城镇的宗教声望因此远播至教团发源的谷地之外。

english:
Kazhi belongs to the Kham highlands around Lithang, where elevated grasslands and deep valleys supported pastoral and farming communities. Yaks, sheep and other livestock supplied food, fibre and transport, while cultivation concentrated in more favourable ground. Routes through the mountains connected different environments, allowing tea, grain, salt and animal products to circulate. Travel depended on pack animals, seasonal access and knowledge of passes.

In the wider Lithang region, monasteries and local rulers formed part of a complex political and religious landscape. Lithang Monastery, also known as Changchun Chokhor, is associated with the Third Dalai Lama, Sonam Gyatso, in the late sixteenth century. Its establishment marked the spread of the Gelug school in this part of Kham. Relations among local authorities, monasteries and more distant powers continued to change during the Qing period.
simp_chinese:
卡孜属于理塘周边康区高地，高海拔草场与深谷支持牧业和农业社区。牦牛、羊等牲畜提供食物、纤维及运输，耕作则集中于条件较好的土地。穿山路线连接不同环境，使茶叶、粮食、盐和畜产品流通。旅行依赖驮畜、季节通行及山口知识。

在更广阔的理塘地区，寺院和地方首领共同构成复杂的政治与宗教环境。理塘寺又称长青春科尔寺，其建立与十六世纪后期的第三世达赖喇嘛索南嘉措有关，是格鲁派在这一带传播的重要节点。清代，地方权威、寺院与远方势力之间的关系继续变化。

english: The Kazhma is a river of the central Siberian taiga, flowing into the Kamenka in the Angara basin. Its course bends through forested country, receiving tributaries before joining the larger river. Long winters freeze the waterways, while the spring thaw and summer rains supply their flow through the valleys of the Siberian interior.
simp_chinese: 卡日马河位于中西伯利亚泰加林，汇入安加拉流域的卡缅卡河。河流在森林地带蜿蜒，接纳支流后汇入较大的河道。漫长冬季使水道封冻，春季融雪与夏雨则供给流经西伯利亚内陆河谷的水流。

english:
Kazimah, often written Kazma, was a name used for both a coastal place near the northwestern head of Kuwait Bay and a larger surrounding territory. It was associated with caravan movement between Mesopotamia and eastern or central Arabia. The geographical name consequently travelled beyond the settlement itself, appearing in descriptions and maps of the northern Gulf.

Seventeenth-century European cartographers placed Kazma with differing degrees of accuracy. Nicolas Sanson's map of 1652 showed it well inland; a later edition moved the label closer to the coast. Eighteenth-century maps continued to use Kazma, including Isaak Tirion's map of 1732 and maps issued by the Ottens brothers and Homann in 1737. Meanwhile, the names Al-Qurain and Kuwait increasingly identified the nearby coastal settlement. The cartographic record preserves overlapping names as the northern Gulf's commercial geography changed. Kazimah's history in this period therefore includes the persistence of an older coastal and regional name alongside the emergence of new port names.
simp_chinese:
卡齐马常写作Kazma，这个名称既指科威特湾西北端附近的海岸地点，也指更大周边地域。它与美索不达米亚通往阿拉伯东部及中部的商队交通相联系，因而越出单一聚落，进入北部海湾的地理描述与地图。

十七世纪欧洲制图者对卡齐马的定位并不一致：桑松1652年地图将其画在较深内陆，后来版本则将标记移近海岸。十八世纪，蒂里翁1732年地图、奥滕斯兄弟和霍曼1737年地图等继续使用Kazma；与此同时，Al-Qurain与Kuwait日益用来标识附近海岸聚落。随着北部海湾商业地理变化，新旧名称在地图上重叠出现，保存了较早海岸与地域名称延续的痕迹。

english:
Kazimierz Dolny stands on the Vistula in the Lublin country. Under Casimir the Great it developed as a royal town with a castle, parish church and market square. Władysław Jagiełło granted Magdeburg law in 1406, the same year as the first recorded mention of its Jewish inhabitants. The river carried grain from Lesser Poland toward Gdańsk, while intersecting overland routes connected merchants travelling between eastern lands, Silesia and Greater Poland.

This combination sustained the town's commercial growth, with its strongest prosperity in the sixteenth and early seventeenth centuries. Warfare later damaged the trading settlement and weakened the conditions on which its wealth depended. Political sovereignty changed again with the partitions: Kazimierz entered the Austrian partition, passed to the Duchy of Warsaw in 1809, and became part of the Kingdom of Poland in 1815. Its history joins the institutions of a royal market town to the opportunities and vulnerabilities of Vistula commerce.
simp_chinese:
卡齐米日多尔尼位于卢布林地区的维斯瓦河畔。卡齐米日大帝在位时，它发展为拥有城堡、堂区教堂和市场的王室城镇。1406年，瓦迪斯瓦夫·雅盖沃授予它马格德堡法地位；同年也出现当地犹太居民的首次记录。河运将小波兰粮食送往格但斯克，交会于此的陆路则连接东部地区、西里西亚与大波兰的商人。

这些条件促进商业发展，十六世纪至十七世纪初尤为繁荣。后来的战火破坏城镇，也削弱了支撑财富的贸易条件。瓜分波兰又改变其政治归属：卡齐米日进入奥地利占领区，1809年转属华沙公国，1815年成为波兰王国的一部分。王室集镇的制度、维斯瓦河贸易带来的机会，以及战争和边界变动造成的脆弱性，共同塑造了它的历史。

english: Kazungala lies where the Chobe joins the Zambezi, at a crossing used for generations between the lands north and south of the river. The Chobe is the lower course of the Kwando, which has travelled from Angola through the Linyanti wetlands. Near its mouth the river divides around islands before its waters meet the broader Zambezi.
simp_chinese: 卡宗加拉位于乔贝河与赞比西河汇合处，河流两岸的人们世代在此渡河。乔贝河是宽多河的下游，河水从安哥拉流来，穿过林扬蒂湿地。在河口附近，水流绕过岛屿分成多道，最终汇入更宽阔的赞比西河。

english: Kazuno lies in a mountain basin of northern Mutsu, crossed by the Yoneshiro River. The district belonged to the Nanbu lords of Morioka, whose lands here met the neighbouring Kubota domain. Fortified residences at Hanawa, Kemanai and Nagaushi survived as local centres of authority. Towns developed along the roads through the basin, while the surrounding hills held mineral deposits and forests.
simp_chinese: 鹿角位于陆奥北部的山间盆地，米代川从中流过。此郡属于盛冈南部氏领地，与邻近的久保田藩接壤。花轮、毛马内和长牛等城馆作为地方权力中心保留下来。町镇沿盆地道路发展，周围山丘则蕴藏矿产并覆盖森林。

english:
Kazym was the name of a Khanty territorial association in the basin of the river of the same name, a tributary of the Ob. Its fortified settlements and princely families belonged to the political world of western Siberia, where ties to the Siberian khanate and demands from Moscow overlapped. In 1593 Russian forces captured Kazym-vosh, and the territory became a tribute-paying volost administered through Berezovo.

Local princes, also called murzas, continued to hold positions within the new arrangement. Conquest nevertheless did not end resistance: in 1607 Bogdan, son of Prince Sengep, joined an uprising and was defeated and executed. Tribute and trade also connected the Kazym Khanty with neighbouring Forest Nenets. Later Russian fortified construction occupied this landscape. The Kazym, or Yuilsk, stockade preserved features of eighteenth-century west Siberian wooden defence, including watchtowers and a barrack building. Kazym's history thus joined indigenous centres of authority to imperial tribute collection and a changing fortified frontier.
simp_chinese:
卡济姆原为鄂毕河支流卡济姆河流域的汉特地域组织。设防聚落与首领家族处在西西伯利亚政治世界中，同西伯利亚汗国的联系及莫斯科的要求相互交叠。1593年，俄军攻取卡济姆沃什，此地转为向别廖佐沃缴纳贡赋的乡区。

称作王公或米尔咱的地方首领继续占有治理位置，但征服并未终结抵抗。1607年，森格普王公之子博格丹参与起事，失败后遭处决。贡赋与贸易也把卡济姆汉特人与邻近森林涅涅茨人相连。后来俄式堡栅进入这片地域；卡济姆、亦称尤伊尔斯克堡，保存十八世纪西西伯利亚木构防御的特征，包括瞭望塔与营房。地方权威、帝国贡赋及设防边地因而在此交织。

english: Kcewite lies among the channels and islands of western Patagonia, near Picton Channel and the Madre de Dios archipelago. Kawésqar families travelled these waters by canoe, moving between islands to fish and gather shellfish. On Madre de Dios, paintings on rock walls preserve images made by people familiar with this intricate coast. Rain, steep wooded shores and sheltered inlets distinguish the archipelago from the grasslands east of the Andes.
simp_chinese: 克塞维特位于巴塔哥尼亚西部水道与岛屿之间，靠近皮克顿水道和马德雷德迪奥斯群岛。卡韦斯卡尔家庭乘独木舟穿行于岛间，捕鱼、采集贝类。马德雷德迪奥斯岛的岩壁上保存着熟悉这片曲折海岸的人们留下的绘画。多雨天气、陡峭林岸和隐蔽海湾，使群岛有别于安第斯山东侧的草原。

english: Kcheeminpink lies near the Cains River in the forested interior of New Brunswick. The Cains runs northeast to join the Southwest Miramichi at Howard; farther downstream the Southwest and Northwest branches meet to form the tidal Miramichi. Dark water flows past wooded banks, and Atlantic salmon return upstream to spawn in the Cains.
simp_chinese: 克奇明平克位于新不伦瑞克内陆林地，靠近凯恩斯河。凯恩斯河向东北流，在霍华德汇入西南米拉米奇河；再向下游，西南支与西北支汇合，成为受潮汐影响的米拉米奇河。深色河水流经林木覆盖的河岸，大西洋鲑鱼则逆流返回凯恩斯河产卵。

english: Keāhole Point projects from the western shore of Hawaiʻi Island into the Pacific. Hawaiian knowledge of this coast recorded strong currents around the point, while canoes connected communities along Kona. An old account describes canoe fleets entering a coastal pond and travelling between Kaʻelehuluhulu and Hoʻonā before returning to the sea.
simp_chinese: 凯阿霍莱角从夏威夷岛西岸伸入太平洋。夏威夷人关于这片海岸的知识记载了岬角附近强劲的海流；独木舟则连接着科纳沿岸的社区。一则古老记述讲到舟队进入海岸鱼池，在卡埃莱胡卢胡卢与霍奥纳之间航行后再返回大海。

english: The Kona coast of Hawaiʻi Island faces west across the Pacific, with sheltered bays between stretches of volcanic shore. Hawaiian communities maintained canoe routes along this coast. In the late eighteenth century Kamehameha drew strength from western anchorages, including nearby Kealakekua Bay, where foreign trading ships later stopped.
simp_chinese: 夏威夷岛的科纳海岸向西面朝太平洋，火山岸线之间分布着有掩护的海湾。夏威夷社群沿岸维持独木舟航路。十八世纪末，卡美哈美哈利用西岸锚地增强实力，其中包括附近的凯阿拉凯夸湾，外国商船后来也在此停靠。

english:
Kealedji was a Creek town whose late eighteenth-century site lay beside Kialijee Creek, a tributary of the Tallapoosa. Benjamin Hawkins described fields occupying narrow creek flats and bends, surrounded by broken, gravelly or stony ground. Pine, oak and small hickory grew nearby. The town also had two dependent villages: Auche nau hatche, where Hawkins noted flourishing peach trees, and Hatchechubba, a small settlement in pine woodland.

The town appears under variant spellings in eighteenth-century lists, including a Spanish record of 1738. Traders attached to it in 1797 included John O'Reilly and Townlay Bruce. Its history also bore the violence of the Creek War: the main town and Hatchechubba were burned by hostile Creeks in 1813. Kealedji nevertheless remained a named community in the list of 1832. These records show a town with its own agricultural setting and dependent settlements, as well as ties to the wider Creek trading world.
simp_chinese:
基阿尔吉是一座克里克城镇，十八世纪末位于塔拉普萨河支流基阿利吉溪旁。本杰明·霍金斯记载，当地田地分布在溪流狭窄的冲积地与河曲间，周围地势破碎，多砾石或石质土壤，生长松树、橡树和小山核桃树。城镇另有两个附属村落：霍金斯在奥切瑙哈切看到长势良好的桃树，哈切丘巴则是松林中的小聚落。

十八世纪的城镇名录以多种拼写记录这里，包括1738年的西班牙文名录。1797年，与城镇交易的商人包括约翰·奥赖利和汤利·布鲁斯。克里克战争也波及当地：1813年，敌对的克里克人烧毁主镇与哈切丘巴。但基阿尔吉仍出现在1832年的社区名录中。这些记录呈现了当地耕作环境、附属村落，以及与克里克贸易网络的联系。

english:
Keban grew in importance through mining during the eighteenth century. Research on its Ottoman institutions describes the expansion of mine operations from the beginning of that century, followed by population growth and a greater role in imperial finance. This developing settlement required new religious and social institutions. Charitable foundations supported mosques and prayer houses in the town and its neighboring villages, giving the mining center an institutional life beyond the extraction of ore.

One surviving expression of that development is the mosque commissioned by the mining administrator Yusuf Ziya Pasha. Built in the late eighteenth century, it occupied sloping ground in the Kallar quarter. Its central dome rests on four slender columns and an octagonal drum, while local stonework frames the building and marble is used for the prayer niche and pulpit. An inscription above the entrance names its patron. The mosque and associated library show how an official connected with mining invested in the built fabric of Keban.
simp_chinese:
凯班在十八世纪因采矿而日益重要。研究奥斯曼地方机构的学者指出，自该世纪初矿场扩大经营后，当地人口随之增长，在帝国财政中的地位也逐渐提高。聚落发展带来了新的宗教与公共设施需求，慈善基金支持城内及附近村庄的清真寺和礼拜所，使矿业中心同时形成相应的社会机构。

矿务长官优素福·齐亚帕夏捐建的清真寺，是这一发展的具体遗存。这座十八世纪末建筑位于卡拉尔街区的坡地上，中央穹顶由四根细柱和八角形鼓座支承，采用地方石工技艺，礼拜龛与讲坛则使用大理石。入口上方的题记记载了捐建者。清真寺及相邻图书馆，体现矿务官员对凯班公共建筑的投入，也使当地历史超出单纯开采矿石的经济叙述。

english: Kebergene lies where the river of that name joins the Indigirka beyond the Arctic Circle. Here the Indigirka crosses northern country of low plains and wooded stretches, with mountains rising beyond them. Its navigable waters provide a passage through the basin in the short open-water season, while winter brings severe cold. The confluence gives this stretch of the river its distinctive place in the landscape.
simp_chinese: 克贝尔格涅位于同名河流汇入因迪吉尔卡河之处，在北极圈以北。因迪吉尔卡河在此穿过北方的平原与林地，远处还有山岭。短暂的无冰季节里，可航的河水为穿行流域提供通道；冬季则严寒漫长。这处汇流地也使当地在河谷中独具位置。

english: Kebili is an oasis in the Nefzaoua region of southern Tunisia, near the eastern edge of Chott el Djerid. Springs and groundwater sustain palm groves in a landscape bounded by the salt depression, the Matmata hills and the Sahara. Date palms shelter gardens and fields, while sand encroaches upon the margins of the oases. Kebili belongs to a chain of settlements that includes Douz farther south.
simp_chinese: 吉比利是突尼斯南部奈夫扎瓦地区的一处绿洲，靠近杰里德盐沼东缘。泉水和地下水滋养着棕榈林，周围则是盐碱洼地、马特马塔山地和撒哈拉。枣椰树荫蔽着花园与田地，而沙地侵入绿洲的边缘。吉比利是这一系列绿洲聚落的一部分，杜兹位于其南方。

english: Kebkabiya lies west of Jebel Marra in Darfur, on routes linking the sultanate's interior with lands farther west. It was a market and an important stopping place for caravan trade. The surrounding uplands receive more rain than the desert to the north, supporting cultivation and grazing around seasonal watercourses. In the eighteenth century Kebkabiya served as a garrison town under Sultan Muhammad Tayrab of Darfur. His armies expanded eastward into Kordofan, while the sultanate maintained long-distance trading connections across the region. The town's position west of the royal centres made it a place where merchants, soldiers and local communities met.
simp_chinese: 凯布凯比亚位于达尔富尔马拉山以西，坐落在连接苏丹国内陆与更西方地区的道路上。它是一处市场，也是商队贸易的重要停靠地。周围高地的雨量多于北方沙漠，季节河道附近可以耕种和放牧。十八世纪，凯布凯比亚是达尔富尔苏丹穆罕默德·泰拉卜治下的驻军城镇。他的军队向东扩张进入科尔多凡，苏丹国同时维持跨地区长途贸易联系。城镇位于王室中心以西，是商人、士兵和当地社群相遇的地方。

english:
The Kechemeche were Lenape people of the Cape May peninsula, between the Atlantic coast and Delaware Bay. Hunting grounds and coastal waters formed part of their homeland before European settlers established themselves there. An account attributed to Robert Evelyn in 1634 described the Kechemeche as a community with about fifty men, one of several Indigenous communities he enumerated in southern New Jersey.

During the seventeenth century, incoming settlers acquired land and developed fishing and whaling settlements. Disease, settlement pressure and changes associated with European farming and livestock reduced the Indigenous population and contributed to movement away from New Jersey. Some families nevertheless remained. Local tradition remembers the leader Nummis, also called Nummy, staying near Cape May and raising his deceased sister's children. Nummytown preserved his name in the landscape, alongside the continuing memory of Kechemeche ties to the peninsula.
simp_chinese:
凯奇米奇人是勒纳佩人的一支，家园位于大西洋与特拉华湾之间的梅角半岛。欧洲殖民者定居以前，陆上猎场与沿海水域已属于他们的生活地域。归于罗伯特·伊夫林的1634年记述，将凯奇米奇列为新泽西南部若干原住民社群之一，记其约有五十名男子。

十七世纪，外来居民取得土地，发展捕鱼与捕鲸聚落。疾病、殖民定居压力，以及欧洲耕作和牲畜带来的环境改变，使原住民人口减少，部分人离开新泽西，仍有家庭留居。地方传统记得首领努米斯，又称努米，留在梅角附近，抚养亡故姊妹的孩子。努米镇的地名保存着他的记忆，也延续了凯奇米奇人与半岛联系的地方叙事。

english: The Kaska Dena have lived for thousands of years in the mountains and river valleys of northern British Columbia. The Kechika River flows northwest through the northernmost stretch of the Rocky Mountain Trench before turning east to join the Liard. Its valley carried a network of routes linking hunting grounds, fishing camps and river crossings. The country is high, glaciated and forested, and in the nineteenth century fur traders began exploring these routes, which the Kaska had used for far longer.
simp_chinese: 卡斯卡德内人在不列颠哥伦比亚北部的山地与河谷中已生活了数千年。凯奇卡河向西北穿过落基山脉北段的大断谷，随后折向东汇入利亚德河。河谷里有一张路网，连接着狩猎场、钓鱼营地与渡口。这里山峰冰封、林木茂密，地势高峻；十九世纪，皮毛商人开始探索这些路线，而卡斯卡人早已将它们使用了更久的时间。

english:
Kecskemét developed as a market town between Buda and Szeged. A royal charter called it an oppidum in 1368, and a document of 1423 referred to its elected judge. Even after the town passed into private lordship, its residents retained important privileges: they chose their officers, paid the lord's dues collectively, and could buy and sell their holdings.

Ottoman rule brought taxation and supervision while the Hungarian judge and council continued to conduct local affairs. Religious life also changed. The medieval stone church of Saint Nicholas was used by Catholics and Protestants during the Reformation. A separate Calvinist church was consecrated in 1684 with the sultan's permission. These arrangements made Kecskemét a town where local institutions endured under overlapping authorities. In the eighteenth century seigneurial justice became more regular: from 1713 the Koháry family's manorial court held sessions there, adding another forum to the town's established judicial life.
simp_chinese:
凯奇凯梅特在布达至塞格德之间发展为集镇。1368年的王室文书称它为市镇，1423年的文书已提及当地选出的法官。即使后来归入私人领主统辖，居民仍保留重要权利：自行推选官员、集体缴纳领主赋税，并可以买卖自己的地产。

奥斯曼统治带来征税与监督，当地匈牙利法官和议事会仍处理城镇事务。宗教生活也在变化：宗教改革时期，天主教徒与新教徒曾共用中世纪的圣尼古拉石教堂。后来另建的加尔文派教堂经苏丹许可，于1684年祝圣。当地制度在多重权威下延续。进入十八世纪，领主司法日趋常规化；1713年起，科哈里家族的领主法庭定期在城中审理案件，为已有的地方司法生活增添另一层机构。

english:
Kedah lies on the western coast of the Malay Peninsula, where rivers descend from forested hills to the Strait of Malacca. Its fertile plain and coastal ports supported a long history of exchange across the strait. Older Hindu and Buddhist remains in the Bujang Valley testify to Kedah's place in maritime networks long before the emergence of its Muslim sultanate.

Kedah's rulers maintained relations with Siam to the north and with European merchants seeking access to the strait. In 1786 the sultan leased Penang to the British East India Company, followed by a strip of mainland in 1800. Relations with Siam deteriorated, and in 1821 Siamese forces invaded Kedah, driving Sultan Ahmad Tajuddin into exile. The occupation brought resistance, including a major revolt in 1831, as the sultan's supporters sought to recover the state.
simp_chinese:
吉打位于马来半岛西岸，河流从林间山丘流向马六甲海峡。肥沃平原与沿海港口支撑了跨海峡贸易的悠久历史。布秧谷地更古老的印度教与佛教遗存，见证了穆斯林苏丹国出现之前吉打在海上网络中的地位。

吉打统治者与北方暹罗及寻求进入海峡的欧洲商人保持关系。1786年，苏丹将槟榔屿租给英国东印度公司，1800年又出租对岸一片土地。与暹罗的关系随后恶化，1821年暹罗军队入侵吉打，迫使苏丹艾哈迈德·塔祖丁流亡。占领引发抵抗，1831年爆发重大起义，苏丹的支持者力图收复国家。

english: The coast of Kedah faces the Strait of Malacca beneath the prominent height of Gunung Jerai. Rivers entering the strait gave access to the Bujang Valley, where ancient Kedah developed as a trading centre. Finds at Pengkalan Bujang include Chinese ceramics and remains dated to the seventh through fourteenth centuries. Its settlements formed part of a network that connected the peninsula with merchants from India, China and other lands across the sea.
simp_chinese: 吉打海岸面向马六甲海峡，醒目的日莱山矗立在岸后。注入海峡的河流通往布秧谷地，古吉打在此发展为贸易中心。朋加兰布秧的发现包括中国陶瓷，以及年代从七世纪至十四世纪的遗存。这里的聚落属于跨海贸易网络的一部分，将半岛与印度、中国及其他地区的商人联系起来。

english:
Kėdainiai lies on the Nevėžis River, north of Kaunas. First recorded in the Livonian chronicle of Hermann of Wartberge in 1372, it became a town in 1590. Its squares and merchants' houses bear witness to a prosperous community in which Lithuanian nobles and immigrants from far beyond the Baltic made their homes.

Under the Radziwiłł family, Kėdainiai became a centre of the Reformed faith. Scottish Protestants arrived in the late sixteenth and seventeenth centuries, and their merchants became influential townsmen. The Calvinist church, built in 1631, contains the family mausoleum, including the tombs of Krzysztof Radziwiłł and his son Janusz. During the Swedish invasion of the Commonwealth, members of the family signed the short-lived Union of Kėdainiai with Sweden at their castle in 1655. The fighting of the Deluge reached the surrounding country, and the agreement did not survive the war.
simp_chinese:
凯代尼艾位于考纳斯以北的内韦日斯河畔。1372年，赫尔曼·冯·瓦特贝格的利沃尼亚编年史首次记载此地；1590年，它获得城市地位。城中的广场和商人住宅见证了这里的繁荣，立陶宛贵族与来自波罗的海以外的移民共同在此定居。

在拉齐维乌家族统治下，凯代尼艾成为归正宗的中心。十六世纪末至十七世纪，苏格兰新教徒来到这里，其中商人在城中颇有影响。建于1631年的加尔文宗教堂内有家族墓室，安葬着克日什托夫·拉齐维乌及其子雅努什。瑞典入侵联邦期间，家族成员于1655年在城堡中与瑞典签署短暂的《凯代尼艾联盟》。大洪水时期的战事波及周边地区，这项协议也未能维持到战争结束。

english:
Kedang was the Yuan county attached to Taozhou, in the Tao River country of present-day Lintan. Its administration belonged to the empire's institutions for the Tibetan frontier, rather than to an ordinary interior prefecture. The county stood within a borderland repeatedly contested by Tibetan and Chinese powers, where the survival and location of fortified centers mattered as much as their official titles.

The Ming established a military-civilian thousand-household command at Taozhou in 1371, subordinate to Hezhou Guard. After the campaign against the eighteen Tibetan tribes in 1379, a new fortified center was built at Donglong Mountain and Taozhou became a guard in its own right. The former Taozhou town remained a fort, leaving old and new administrative sites in the same district. Under the Qing, the guard was attached to Gongchang Prefecture in 1730, then replaced by Taozhou Subprefecture in 1748. A subprefect responsible for relations with Tibetan communities governed the district. These successive arrangements made Kedang's country a meeting place of county government, military colonization and negotiated frontier authority.
simp_chinese:
可当是元代洮州所辖的县，位于今临潭一带的洮河地区。它隶属元朝管理藏地边疆的机构，行政体系有别于内地普通府县。吐蕃及中原政权曾反复争夺这一带，筑城据守和治所迁移，与官署名号的变化同样影响地方格局。

1371年，明廷在洮州设置军民千户所，隶属河州卫。1379年征讨洮州十八族之后，又在东陇山筑起新城，洮州升为独立的卫。旧洮州城则保留为堡，使同一地区同时留下新旧两处治理中心。清代继续沿用卫制，1730年改隶巩昌府，1748年再撤卫设洮州厅，派抚番同知管理。由元代县治到明代军卫，再到清代的厅，这片土地接连经历不同治理安排，官府、驻军及周围藏族社群之间的关系始终是地方历史的重要部分。

english: Kedang Pahu is a tributary of the Mahakam in eastern Borneo. It joins the larger river at Muara Pahu, upstream of the broad lowland lakes of Semayang and Melintang. Below the confluence, the Mahakam crosses a flat country of lakes and peatlands before winding toward its delta and the Makassar Strait. These connected waterways form one of the island's major routes between the forested interior and the sea.
simp_chinese: 克当帕胡河是婆罗洲东部马哈坎河的一条支流，在穆阿拉帕胡汇入干流，位于瑟马扬湖和默林当湖等低地湖泊的上游。汇合之后，马哈坎河穿过湖泊与泥炭地交错的平原，蜿蜒流向三角洲和望加锡海峡。这些相连水道是岛上森林内陆与海洋之间的重要通路。

english: Lake Amut lies high in the Miao-Chan Range amid the wooded mountains west of the lower Amur. The lake was formed by a landslide, which blocked the valley of the Amut River. The river enters the lake at one end and leaves it at the other, continuing through the mountain country.
simp_chinese: 阿穆特湖位于黑龙江下游以西苗场岭的高山林地中。一次山体滑坡阻塞阿穆特河谷，形成了这座湖泊。阿穆特河从湖的一端流入，另一端流出，继续穿过山地。

english: The Kedon Range is part of the Kolyma Highlands, a country of bare ridges and river valleys in northeastern Siberia. Its mountains arc west of the Omolon, while the Kedon River cuts through them on its northward course. Sparse larch woods grow in the valleys below the exposed slopes. Tectonic basins separate these highlands from neighbouring ranges, and the southern mountains merge into the Molkaty Range.
simp_chinese: 克东山脉是科雷马高地的一部分，位于西伯利亚东北部，裸露山脊与河谷交错。山脉在奥莫隆河以西弯曲延伸，克东河向北流过山间。裸露山坡下的河谷中，稀疏生长着落叶松林。构造盆地将这片高地与邻近山脉分开，其南端则与莫尔卡特山脉相接。

english:
Kedu Pass guards an old route between Yunnan and Guizhou in the mountains north of Xuanwei. A stone road winds across the slopes towards a fortified gateway and the river crossing, making it a natural point of passage for officials, merchants and couriers. The surrounding mountain country made the pass a distinctive entrance to the Yunnan plateau.

A small walled settlement was built at the pass in 1382, early in the Ming conquest of Yunnan. The government established a relay station and an inspection post along the road, while soldiers and labourers maintained the route. In the Qing, the pass continued to supervise traffic, including the transport of copper. The old road and its surviving stones recall centuries of travel across the plateau frontier.
simp_chinese:
可渡关扼守宣威以北山地中连接云南与贵州的古道。石板路沿山坡蜿蜒，通向关门和河流渡口，是官员、商人与驿使往来的要隘。周围群山使这里成为进入云南高原的独特门户。

1382年，明朝平定云南之初在关隘修筑小城，随后沿路设置驿站和巡检司，由军民维护道路。驿站为传递公文和行旅提供服务。清代可渡关继续管理交通，其中包括铜料运输。古道、关门和留存石刻见证了数百年来穿越高原边地的行旅。

english: Kedun was a fortified centre in the Tuul valley, on the northern frontier of the Liao empire. Chinese chronicles describe a Khitan town established on the site of an earlier Uighur settlement. In 1004 the Liao stationed twenty thousand cavalry in this region and assigned families of Bohai, Jurchen and Chinese origin to supply them. Earthen walls and archaeological remains in the valley recall the fortified settlements that guarded this frontier of the steppe.
simp_chinese: 克敦是土兀剌河谷的一处设防中心，位于辽帝国的北部边疆。中国史书记载，契丹人在一座较早的回鹘城址上建立了城镇。1004年，辽朝在这一地区部署两万骑兵，并安排渤海、女真和汉人家户供应军需。河谷中的土筑城墙与考古遗存，展现了曾经守卫草原边疆的设防聚落。

english: Kèèlivtyn takes its Chukchi name from a snowfield on the steep bank of the Anadyr River. Downstream from the mouth of the Belaya, the Anadyr winds east through a broad lowland toward the Bering Sea. The river is a defining feature of this northern landscape, frozen through the long winter and opening during the short summer, when its waters spread across the valley.
simp_chinese: 基利夫廷的楚科奇语名称来自阿纳德尔河陡岸上的一片雪地。白河河口下游，阿纳德尔河蜿蜒向东，穿过广阔低地，流向白令海。这条河是北方景观的重要组成部分：漫长冬季河面封冻，短暂夏季解冻后，河水漫布谷地。

english: Kéex Kwáan is a Tlingit community of the island channels around Kupreanof Island. Its people travelled by canoe among the forested shores and salmon streams of southeastern Alaska, and maintained ties with neighbouring Tlingit communities. Warriors from Kake joined allies at Sitka in 1802 when the Tlingit attacked a Russian post. In the following years American trading ships visited Kake seeking sea otter skins, bringing the fur trade into waters already known to local people.
simp_chinese: 基克斯宽是库普雷阿诺夫岛周围水道的特林吉特社群。人们乘独木舟往来于阿拉斯加东南部的森林海岸和鲑鱼溪流之间，与邻近特林吉特社群保持联系。1802年，来自凯克的战士与锡特卡的盟友共同攻击俄国据点。此后数年，美国贸易船到访凯克寻找海獭皮，将毛皮贸易带入当地居民早已熟悉的水域。

english: Keflavík, the “bay of driftwood,” lies on the Reykjanes peninsula in southwestern Iceland. The settlement developed around fishing and the processing of its catch, drawing on the waters of the North Atlantic. Scottish entrepreneurs established themselves here in the sixteenth century, contributing to the growth of the harbor. Its name evokes the timber carried to Iceland's shores by the sea, a valuable resource on an island with few trees large enough to supply the needs of ships and buildings.
simp_chinese: 凯夫拉维克意为「浮木之湾」，位于冰岛西南部的雷克雅内斯半岛。聚落围绕北大西洋的渔业和渔获加工发展。十六世纪，苏格兰商人在此落脚，促进港口成长。地名令人想起海水带到冰岛海岸的木材：在这座缺少足以满足船舶与建筑需要的大树的岛屿上，浮木是一种宝贵资源。

english: Kegaska was a named harbour and coastal landmark on the lower north shore of the Gulf of St Lawrence in the seventeenth century. Franquelin's map of 1685 recorded Quegasca. Louis Jolliet used the name in 1694 for both the harbour, where he stopped on August 10, and a nearby point. In 1702 the spelling Kegaska appeared in the grant of hunting and fishing territory to Augustin Le Gardeur de Courtemanche. By 1831 the Hudson's Bay Company maintained a trading post here, adding a commercial station to the older harbour name. Admiral Bayfield used the spelling Kegashka in 1837, one of several forms through which the name passed. Its history thus belongs chiefly to the harbour, the hunting and fishing concession and the trading post.
simp_chinese: 凯加斯卡位于圣劳伦斯湾下北岸，十七世纪时已是有名的港湾和海岸地标。弗朗克兰1685年的地图将其记作Quegasca。1694年，路易·若利耶也以此名称指称港湾及附近岬角，并于8月10日在港湾停留。1702年，授予奥古斯坦·勒加德尔·德库尔特芒什的狩猎和捕鱼领地文书中，已经出现Kegaska这一拼写。到1831年，哈得孙湾公司在此维持贸易站，使旧有港名又与商业据点联系起来。贝菲尔德海军上将于1837年采用Kegashka拼法，反映了地名书写的多次变化。它的历史因此主要属于港湾、狩猎捕鱼特许领地和贸易站。

english: Kegen lies in the high country of southeastern Zhetysu, near a river of the same name. Mountain streams gather to form the Kegen, which flows through a valley before continuing as the Charyn. Farther downstream the Charyn cuts deep canyons on its way toward the Ili. The upper valley and its surrounding mountain pastures form part of the varied landscape north of the Tian Shan.
simp_chinese: 凯根位于七河东南部的高地，靠近同名河流。山间溪水汇成凯根河，河流穿过谷地后改称恰伦河；再往下游，恰伦河在流向伊犁河途中切出深邃峡谷。上游河谷与周围山地牧场，共同构成天山以北多样的景观，山水在这里塑造了通往低地的道路。

english:
Keglo Bay belongs to the northern waters around Hudson Strait, where ice, tides and seasonal weather shape travel. Inuit communities drew on marine animals, fish and other resources, using detailed knowledge of the coast. Boats supported summer travel and hunting; in winter, routes followed sea ice and snow-covered land. Landing and camping places formed part of knowledge passed between generations.

European voyages entered the wider Hudson Strait region in search of northern passages and later supported trade around Hudson Bay. From the seventeenth century, ships serving trading posts connected the Atlantic with inland commercial networks. Crews faced a short sailing season and hazardous ice, while local people pursued their own interests through exchange, cooperation and sometimes conflict.
simp_chinese:
凯格洛湾属于哈得孙海峡周边的北方水域，冰、潮汐和季节天气影响航行。因纽特社群依靠海兽、鱼类等资源生活，积累了对海岸和环境变化的知识。夏季人们乘船出行、狩猎，冬季则沿海冰和积雪陆地旅行。适宜登陆和宿营的地点也由世代传承。

欧洲探险船在寻找北方通道时进入哈得孙海峡，后来船只又为哈得孙湾贸易提供支持。十七世纪起，服务贸易站的船只通过海峡连接大西洋与内陆贸易网络。船员面对短暂航季和危险冰况，当地居民则在交换、合作及有时发生的冲突中维护自身利益。

english: Kegum Kagati Lake lies in the low country of the Yukon–Kuskokwim delta in western Alaska. Its name means “head of the Keguk,” the river that flows south from the lake to meet the Kinia. About six miles across, the lake is one of many waters scattered through the delta. Its outlet carries water away through a landscape of channels and wetlands toward the Bering Sea.
simp_chinese: 凯古姆卡加蒂湖坐落在阿拉斯加西部育空—库斯科奎姆三角洲的低地。湖名意为“凯古克河源头”，凯古克河从湖中向南流出，汇入基尼亚河。这座宽约六英里的湖泊是三角洲众多水域之一；湖水流经河汊与湿地，向白令海方向而去。

english: Kehukee Creek flows through the low country of northeastern Carolina to the Roanoke River. The swampy watercourse gave its name to a Baptist meeting house established by William Sojourner around 1742, after he had acquired land in the creek's basin. The congregation became an early centre of Baptist life in the region. In 1769 churches from the surrounding country formed the Kehukee Association, named for the meeting house by the creek.
simp_chinese: 克豪基溪流经卡罗来纳东北部的低地，汇入罗阿诺克河。这条沼泽水道为一座浸信会聚会所命名：威廉·索杰纳在溪流域取得土地后，于1742年前后建立了这座聚会所。会众成为当地早期浸信会活动的中心。1769年，周围地区的教会组成克豪基协会，名称正来自溪畔的聚会所。

english: Kehek Aike is an Aonikenk name for the country near the southern shore of Lago Argentino, later known as El Calafate. The name has been explained as a stopping place where belongings were deposited. The lake lies at the edge of the Patagonian Andes, with glacial valleys to the west and dry steppe to the east. Aonikenk people travelled through this landscape between the mountains and the Atlantic plains.
simp_chinese: 克赫克艾克是奥尼肯克人对阿根廷湖南岸地区的名称，这里后来称为埃尔卡拉法特。名称被解释为存放物品的停留地。湖泊位于巴塔哥尼亚安第斯山脉边缘，西侧有冰川谷地，东侧是干燥草原。奥尼肯克人曾穿过山地与大西洋平原之间的这一景观。

english: Kehsi lies among the valleys and wooded hills of the Shan Plateau. It was the chief town of Kehsi Mansam, a Shan principality whose lands included the smaller territory of Kenglon. The surrounding uplands are cut by streams and valleys, with the Salween flowing through the broader country to the east. Like other Shan centres, Kehsi stood in a landscape of local communities and neighbouring principalities.
simp_chinese: 克西位于掸邦高原的河谷与森林丘陵之间，曾是克西曼桑掸邦小国的中心，其辖地包括较小的耿隆地区。溪流与谷地切开周围高地，萨尔温江则流经更东面的广阔地区。克西与其他掸邦中心一样，处于地方社区与邻近小邦交错的土地上。

english:
Kehu stood on the Shanxi bank of the Yellow River opposite Jiazhou, at a crossing linking the province with northern Shaanxi. Its earlier name survived in several written forms, including Kehu and Kehuzhai. Although the Yuan period reduced its old military role, local gazetteer tradition records the construction of the Stone Buddha Temple here in 1343.

The Ming restored an official security presence in 1372 by establishing a patrol inspectorate at the crossing. The Yongle encyclopaedia described its steep riverside position and the route west towards Shenmu and the desert, explaining why this small place warranted supervision. By the seventeenth century, Gu Zuyu's geographical account recalled an earlier floating bridge but described the crossing as served by boats. Qing records retained a small garrison at the renamed Kehuzhai. Temple, patrol office and ferry each show a different use of the same riverbank settlement as military frontiers and administrative arrangements changed.
simp_chinese:
克胡位于黄河山西岸，与葭州隔河相望，是连接山西与陕北的渡口。旧名在文献中写作克胡、克狐寨等不同形式。元代，其原有军事作用减弱，但地方志传统记载，1343年这里兴建了石佛寺。

明朝于1372年在渡口设置巡检司，恢复官方治安机构。《永乐大典》描述其临河陡峻的地势，以及向西通往神木、直达沙漠的道路，说明这个小地方为何需要设官监督。到十七世纪，顾祖禹的地理著作追述这里早先曾架浮桥，当时则以船只渡河。清代文献仍为改称克虎寨的地点登记少量驻兵。寺院、巡检司与渡口，显示同一河岸聚落在边防与行政安排变动中的不同用途。

english: The Great Kei River reaches the Indian Ocean through an estuary on the southeastern African coast. Its waters descend from the interior between the lands of Xhosa-speaking communities. During the eighteenth century, rival branches of the Xhosa ruling lineage came to be centred on opposite sides of the Kei: the Gcaleka to the east and the Ngqika between the Kei and the Fish River to the west.
simp_chinese: 大凯河通过河口注入非洲东南岸外的印度洋。河水从内陆流下，穿过说科萨语的社群居住的土地。十八世纪，科萨统治家系的对立支派逐渐以凯河两岸为中心：东面是加莱卡人，西面凯河与菲什河之间则是恩吉卡人。

sources.title: leonard monteath thompson a history of south afrbook4me.org -1.pdf

english: Kekerengū Bank lies offshore from the northeastern coast of New Zealand's South Island, south of Cape Campbell. The submarine bank takes its name from Kekerengū on the mainland coast. The nearby shore and Cook Strait were part of a Māori world of coastal travel and settlements long before European charts recorded these waters.
simp_chinese: 凯凯伦古浅滩位于新西兰南岛东北岸外、坎贝尔角以南。海底浅滩以大陆海岸的凯凯伦古命名。欧洲海图记录这些水域之前，附近海岸和库克海峡已属于毛利人沿海旅行与聚落的世界。

english:
Keku Strait ran between Kuiu and Kupreanof islands in the island country of southeastern Alaska. It connected the waters of Frederick Sound with the approaches to Sumner Strait, through channels broken by islands, reefs and tidal shallows. This was country of the Kake Tlingit, whose permanent villages stood on both large islands and whose claims extended around the northern Kuiu shore. Seasonal fishing places formed part of the same maritime landscape.

Near the northern end, a traditional summer camp occupied the shore later used for the Kake cannery. There people caught and preserved salmon; shellfish and seaweed were gathered along the rocky beach. Such places linked residence with the seasonal work that supplied stored food. Foreign surveying added another layer of names in the late eighteenth century. In 1793 Vancouver gave the name Conclusion Island to an island in the southern part of Keku Strait, marking the end of that season's work. His charting entered waters already used and named by local people, whose villages and fishing grounds gave the passage an older human geography.
simp_chinese:
凯库海峡位于阿拉斯加东南的奎尤岛与库普里亚诺夫岛之间，经散布岛屿、礁石与潮汐浅滩的水道，将弗雷德里克湾同萨姆纳海峡方向连接起来。这里属于卡克特林吉特人的海上地区，他们在两座大岛上拥有固定村落，地方氏族的土地关系也延伸到奎尤岛北岸，季节捕鱼地点同样属于这一生活空间。

北端附近一处传统夏季营地，后来才成为卡克罐头厂用地。人们在此捕捞、保存鲑鱼，也从岩岸采集贝类与海藻，将季节劳作同储粮、居住相联系。十八世纪末，外国测绘又添上新的地名。1793年，温哥华将海峡南部的一座岛命名为“终结岛”，纪念当季勘测结束。他所绘制的水道早已有本地居民使用，海峡沿线的村落与渔场也拥有更久远的人文历史。

english: Kekwapskuk lies by the Northumberland Strait, near Pictou Harbour and the estuary of the East River. Mi'kmaq families lived around the harbour long before the arrival of British settlers. In 1773 the ship Hector brought Highland Scots to Pictou; Mi'kmaq neighbours supplied food and shared knowledge that helped the newcomers through their first winters.
simp_chinese: 凯克瓦普斯克克靠近诺森伯兰海峡、皮克图港与东河河口。早在英国移民到来之前，米克马克人便生活在港湾周围。1773年，“赫克托”号载着苏格兰高地移民抵达皮克图；米克马克邻居提供食物，传授当地知识，帮助他们度过最初几个冬天。

english: Kel'tegey lies between the Kular Range and the lower Yana. The Kular mountains arc northeastward west of the Yana and form part of the Verkhoyansk system. Beyond them the Yana flows toward its broad delta on the Laptev Sea.
simp_chinese: 克尔捷格伊位于库拉尔山脉与亚纳河下游之间。库拉尔山脉在亚纳河以西向东北延伸，属于上扬斯克山系；山脉之外，亚纳河流向拉普捷夫海畔宽广的三角洲。

english: Kelaelkces names a Kawésqar territorial group of the Última Esperanza region, where deep channels and inlets divide the southern Patagonian coast. Its neighbours included the Kcewíte to the north and the Tawókser around the Strait of Magellan to the south. Kawésqar families travelled these waters by canoe, drawing on an intimate knowledge of sheltered landings, currents and the resources of the shore.
simp_chinese: 凯拉埃尔克塞斯是南巴塔哥尼亚乌尔蒂马埃斯佩兰萨地区的卡维斯卡尔人地域群体名称。这一带深邃的水道与海湾切割着海岸，北邻克切维特人的地域，南接麦哲伦海峡一带的塔沃克塞尔人。卡维斯卡尔家庭乘独木舟航行于水道之间，熟知避风登陆处、潮流和海岸资源。

english: Kelafo stands beside the Shabelle River in the Somali country of eastern Ethiopia. The river brings water from the highlands across a landscape otherwise marked by dry plains and seasonal rainfall. Its banks support cultivation as well as the movement of pastoral herds. The settlement is associated with the Ajuran sultanate, whose authority extended along the upper Shabelle before its decline in the seventeenth century.
simp_chinese: 克拉福坐落在埃塞俄比亚东部索马里地区的谢贝利河畔。河流把高地的水带入干旱平原和季节性降雨的地区，河岸既支持耕作，也供牧群往来。这里与阿朱兰苏丹国有关；在十七世纪衰落之前，其势力曾延伸至谢贝利河上游。

english:
Kelan occupied a mountain enclosure in northwestern Shanxi, combining civil administration with the defence of the northern frontier. During the Hongwu reign the Ming established Zhenxi Guard here in 1374, rebuilt the town's defences and restored a civil jurisdiction that soon became Kelan subprefecture. Civil officials and military commanders consequently shared the same walled centre, while soldiers were assigned to the frontier around Pianguan and Datong.

The organisation of this border country continued to change. In 1539 the military administration associated with Zhang Wei moved from Shizhou to Kelan and established an office on Juren Street. Later in the Ming the official headquarters shifted to Pianguan, leaving Kelan as a place visited on inspection circuits. Nearby strongpoints such as Wuzhai and Sancha formed part of the wider defensive landscape. Qing administration retained Kelan's civil identity while replacing the guard commander with a garrison officer. The town's history was therefore shaped by overlapping civil and military institutions and by the movement of frontier authority between fortified centres.
simp_chinese:
岢岚位于山西西北群山环绕之地，兼具地方治理与北部边防的职能。明洪武七年，即1374年，朝廷在此设置镇西卫，修筑城防，随后恢复县级建置并很快升为岢岚州。州署与卫治同处一座城内，卫军则分赴偏关、大同等处戍守，地方行政与军务在这里紧密交织。

这片边地的组织此后仍有调整。嘉靖十八年，即1539年，张伟所掌兵备机构从石州移驻岢岚，在居仁街建立衙署。明代后期，兵备驻地又迁往偏关，岢岚成为官员巡按途经之处。附近五寨、三岔等堡寨也构成更广阔防御体系的一部分。清代延续岢岚的州级建置，同时裁去卫指挥使，改设守备统领。城镇的历史由民政与军事机构共同塑造，边防权力在不同城堡之间的转移，也不断改变岢岚在区域中的位置。

english:
Kelantan occupies the northeastern Malay Peninsula, where the Kelantan River reaches the South China Sea. Its fertile river plain is enclosed by forested highlands, and the river links the coast with settlements inland. Malay courts and Muslim religious traditions shaped the region, while its position brought it into contact with neighbouring Patani, Terengganu and Siam.

In the eighteenth century Long Yunus established a new ruling dynasty in Kelantan after a long period of local conflict. His heirs contested power after his death, and neighbouring rulers intervened in the struggle. By the early nineteenth century Kelantan had entered Siam's sphere of influence. The history of its court reflects the changing alliances among the Malay states and their more powerful northern neighbour.
simp_chinese:
吉兰丹位于马来半岛东北部，吉兰丹河在此注入南海。肥沃的河流平原被森林高地环抱，大河将海岸与内陆聚落相连。马来宫廷与穆斯林宗教传统塑造了这一地区，其位置也使它与邻近的北大年、丁加奴和暹罗保持联系。

十八世纪，龙尤努斯在冲突之后于吉兰丹建立统治家族。他去世后，继承者争夺权力，邻国统治者也介入纷争。十九世纪初，吉兰丹进入暹罗的势力范围。其宫廷历史反映了马来诸邦与强大的北方邻国之间不断变化的联盟。

english: The Kelantan coast faces the South China Sea along the northeastern Malay Peninsula. The Kelantan River reaches the sea through branching mouths, depositing sediment on a low and sandy shore. Waves driven by the northeast monsoon move sand along the coast and have shifted the position of the river mouth. The same monsoon brings heavy rain and rough seas, shaping both the river’s seasonal floods and the rhythm of coastal fishing.
simp_chinese: 吉兰丹海岸位于马来半岛东北部，面向南海。吉兰丹河通过分岔的河口入海，在低平沙岸沉积泥沙。东北季风推动的波浪沿岸搬运沙粒，使河口位置发生移动。季风还带来大雨和汹涌海浪，影响河流的季节性洪水和沿岸捕鱼的节奏。

english: Kelapur lies in the southern part of Berar, in the country between the Deccan plateau and the forests farther east. A stone fort once stood in the village, distinct from the earthen strongholds found in many neighbouring settlements. The local temple of Jagdamba is another long-standing feature of the place. Nearby rivers and routes connect this part of Vidarbha with the lands to the south and the broader plains of Berar.
simp_chinese: 凯拉布尔位于贝拉尔南部，处在德干高原与东面森林之间。村中曾有一座石堡，与邻近许多聚落常见的土堡不同。当地的杰格丹巴神庙也是历史悠久的地标。附近河流和道路将维达尔巴这一部分与南方土地及更广阔的贝拉尔平原连接起来。

english: Kelay lies along a river of eastern Borneo, in the forested interior of the Berau country. The Kelay flows northeast to meet the Segah at Tanjung Redeb; together they form the Berau River, which reaches the sea through a network of channels. Tributaries enter both rivers from the surrounding forests, making the basin an extensive system of waterways linking the interior with the eastern coast of the island.
simp_chinese: 克雷位于婆罗洲东部伯劳地区的森林内陆，得名于流经此地的河流。克雷河向东北流，在丹绒勒德布与瑟加河汇合，形成伯劳河，后者经多条水道入海。两条河流都接纳周围森林中的支流，构成连接内陆与岛屿东岸的广阔水系。

english: Kele lies in the country south of the lower Aldan, near the broad Lena basin. Farther north the river called Kele descends from the Verkhoyansk Range and winds through a lake-filled floodplain before joining the Aldan, which itself flows into the Lena.
simp_chinese: 克列位于阿尔丹河下游以南、广阔的勒拿河流域附近。更北面的克列河从上扬斯克山脉流出，蜿蜒穿过遍布湖泊的泛滥平原，汇入阿尔丹河；阿尔丹河最终流入勒拿河。

english: The waters near New Georgia belong to the western Solomon Islands, where islands and reefs enclose sheltered lagoons. Roviana Lagoon was a centre of regional power, and its communities built large canoes for voyages and raids. Sea routes linked the lagoon with neighbouring islands across the archipelago.
simp_chinese: 新乔治亚岛附近水域属于所罗门群岛西部，岛屿和礁石环抱受庇护的潟湖。罗维亚纳潟湖曾是地区权力中心，当地社群建造大型独木舟用于航行和袭击。海路将潟湖与群岛中的邻近岛屿连接起来。

english:
Kelheim stands at the meeting of the Altmühl and the Danube, below a promontory once enclosed by the ramparts of a great Celtic settlement. In the Middle Ages the town grew under the Wittelsbach dukes of Bavaria. Duke Ludwig I reshaped its streets and strengthened its walls, but in 1231 he was stabbed to death by an unknown attacker at the town gate.

River traffic, crafts and agriculture sustained the town, whose citizens also earned a living from fishing and viticulture. War reached Kelheim in the eighteenth century, when Austrian troops occupied it. In 1705 a rising led by the master butcher Matthias Kraus drove the occupiers out briefly; they returned, suppressed the revolt and put its leader to death. Nearby, the Asam brothers fashioned the Baroque church of Weltenburg Abbey beside the Danube.
simp_chinese:
凯尔海姆位于阿尔特米尔河与多瑙河交汇处，俯瞰城镇的岬地上，曾有一座大型凯尔特聚落的土垒。中世纪时，城镇在巴伐利亚维特尔斯巴赫家族公爵统治下发展。路德维希一世重整街道、加固城墙，却于1231年在城门口被一名身份不明的刺客刺死。

河运、手工业与农业支撑着城镇，居民也以捕鱼和种植葡萄为生。十八世纪战火波及凯尔海姆，奥地利军队曾占领此地。1705年，屠夫师傅马蒂亚斯·克劳斯领导起义，短暂赶走占领军；他们随即返回镇压叛乱，并处死了领袖。附近的多瑙河畔，阿萨姆兄弟为韦尔滕堡修道院设计了巴洛克式教堂。

english:
Kelibia's citadel crowns a rocky headland on the northeastern side of Cape Bon. Its walls overlooked the sea passage toward Sicily and the nearby anchorage, while the town developed in the shadow of a fortress repeatedly rebuilt by successive rulers. Under the Hafsids, the stronghold also served a religious role as a centre of ascetic life. Its inherited military and devotional functions remained closely tied to this exposed stretch of the Tunisian coast.

In the sixteenth century, Kelibia became a site of conflict between Ottoman and Spanish forces. During the seventeenth century, the rulers of Tunis strengthened its defences and enlarged the garrison to protect an anchorage used by privateering vessels. French naval reprisals followed later in that century. As privateering declined in the eighteenth century, the fortress received less attention. The changing condition of the citadel reflected the fortunes of the anchorage below: the same position that sheltered armed shipping also made the town vulnerable to attacks from across the Mediterranean.
simp_chinese:
古莱比耶堡垒矗立于邦角东北侧岩岬，俯视通往西西里的海路与附近锚地。城镇的发展与历代统治者反复修建的堡垒相连；哈夫斯时期，堡内也有苦修活动，军事与宗教功能共同塑造这段面海的突尼斯海岸。

十六世纪，古莱比耶成为奥斯曼与西班牙军队交战之地。十七世纪，突尼斯统治者加固防御并扩充驻军，保护供私掠船只使用的锚地；此后法国舰队展开报复性袭击。十八世纪私掠活动衰退，堡垒也逐渐疏于维护。堡垒境况的变化反映出山下锚地的兴衰：容纳武装船只的位置，同时也使城镇暴露于来自地中海对岸的攻击之下。

english: Kelich stands on the Yum, a tributary of the Kosa in the upper Kama country. A map of 1734–1736 shows the settlement under the name Kulich. By the early nineteenth century court records refer to a separate Kelich volost of state peasants. Its river belongs to the network of waterways running through the forested lands west of the Kama, where Komi-Permyak and Russian communities lived among the tributaries and their valleys.
simp_chinese: 克利奇位于尤姆河畔，这条河是卡马河上游地区科萨河的支流。1734至1736年的地图以库利奇之名标出了聚落。到十九世纪初，法院档案已提及一个由国有农民组成的独立克利奇乡。尤姆河属于卡马河以西林地的水系，科米—彼尔米亚克人和俄罗斯人居住在支流及其河谷之间。

english: Kelif lies by the Amu Darya, where the river passes between the dry lands of Khorasan and Transoxiana. Medieval routes followed and crossed the Oxus here, connecting river settlements to the caravan roads of the interior. Downstream, Kerki and Amul stood along the same great waterway. The river brought a strip of water and cultivation through a country otherwise marked by desert and steppe.
simp_chinese: 凯利夫位于阿姆河畔，大河在呼罗珊与河中的干旱地带之间流过。中世纪的道路沿奥克苏斯河伸展并在此渡河，将沿河聚落与内陆商道连接。下游的克尔基和阿模里也坐落在同一水道上。大河在沙漠与草原之间带来一条水源和耕作地带。

english: The Kelimyar rises on the southeastern slopes of the Chekanovsky Ridge and flows into the Olenyok from the right. Its course crosses the northern country between the Olenyok and lower Lena, far beyond the Arctic Circle. The tributary joins the Olenyok above its broad delta, through which that river reaches the Laptev Sea. Long winter ice and the brief summer govern the rivers of this remote landscape.
simp_chinese: 克利米亚尔河发源于切卡诺夫斯基岭东南坡，从右岸注入厄列尼奥克河。它穿过厄列尼奥克河与勒拿河下游之间的北方土地，远在北极圈以内。支流在厄列尼奥克河宽阔三角洲上游汇入大河，后者经三角洲注入拉普捷夫海。漫长冰封和短暂夏季支配着这片偏远地区的河流。

english: Kelinjau lies in the forested interior of eastern Borneo, beside a river of the same name. The Kelinjau connects settlements in the inland country and forms part of the waterways leading toward the Mahakam. Its riverbanks belong to a broad basin whose streams carry water from the hills through tropical forest. Changing water levels can make passage along these waterways easier or more difficult as the seasons turn.
simp_chinese: 克林召位于婆罗洲东部的森林内陆，邻近一条同名河流。克林召河连接内陆地区的聚落，属于通往马哈坎河的水系。它的河岸处在广阔的流域中，溪流将丘陵的水带过热带森林。随着季节变化，水位升降使这些水道的通行条件随之改变。

english:
Kelkit's late medieval history was shaped by competing powers in northeastern Anatolia. Conflict between the Qara Qoyunlu and Aq Qoyunlu affected the district before Ottoman consolidation. After the campaign culminating at Chaldiran in 1514, Sultan Selim I incorporated Kelkit with the Bayburt region. Feruhsad Bey, an Aq Qoyunlu ally against the Safavids, received extensive land revenues around Bayburt and Kelkit.

Sixteenth-century land and endowment registers place Kelkit-Sadak as a subdistrict under the Bayburt sanjak. The area was attached to the newly established Erzurum provincial government in 1535, after a period within Diyarbekir's administration. These changes locate the valley within specific Ottoman institutions rather than an unspecified imperial frontier. Its earlier strategic importance as an eastern border district diminished as Ottoman territory expanded farther east towards the end of the century. Kelkit's position thus changed through conquest, rewards to an allied notable and the reorganisation of provincial authority.
simp_chinese:
凯尔基特的中世纪后期历史受到安纳托利亚东北部竞争势力影响。奥斯曼巩固统治以前，黑羊与白羊王朝的冲突波及当地。1514年查尔迪兰战役之后，塞利姆一世将凯尔基特同巴伊布尔特地区纳入奥斯曼。白羊王朝的费鲁赫沙德贝伊因协助对抗萨法维，在巴伊布尔特和凯尔基特周围获得大片土地收益权。

十六世纪土地与宗教捐产登记，将凯尔基特—萨达克列为巴伊布尔特桑贾克下的分区。地区一度属迪亚巴克尔，1535年转入新设埃尔祖鲁姆省级治理体系。这些变化使河谷落实于具体奥斯曼制度之中。随着领土继续向东扩展，其作为东部边境的早期战略重要性，到十六世纪末逐渐下降。当地地位因征服、酬赏盟友和省区重组而发生变化。

english: Kellé lies in the dry country east of Zinder, near the Koutous uplands. Here the Sahel gives way towards the desert, and local communities combine cultivation with the keeping of herds. Kanuri-speaking Dagara, Fulani and Tuareg groups have all lived in this region, whose sparse vegetation and seasonal water shape movement through the land.
simp_chinese: 凯莱位于津德尔以东的干旱地区，靠近库图高地。萨赫勒在这里逐渐过渡为沙漠，居民兼营耕作与畜牧。说卡努里语的达加拉人、富拉尼人和图阿雷格人都生活在这一地区，稀疏植被和季节性水源影响着人们的移动。

english: Keller Lake lies south of Great Bear Lake in the northern Canadian interior. Roughly triangular in shape, it drains northward through the Johnny Hoe River into the larger lake. Salmonid fish inhabit its waters, while the surrounding plains include bogs and stands of black spruce. The lake is part of a northern landscape of forest, wetlands and waterways stretching toward the Mackenzie River.
simp_chinese: 凯勒湖位于加拿大北部内陆、大熊湖南方。湖面大致呈三角形，湖水经约翰尼霍河向北流入大熊湖。鲑科鱼类生活在湖中，周围平原上则有沼泽和黑云杉林。湖泊所在的北方地区森林、湿地与水道交错，一直延伸到马更些河方向。

english: Kellollampu, or Tierra Amarilla, lies in the Copiapó valley amid the dry mountains of northern Chile. Its name is associated with the yellow earth of the valley, where river water supports cultivation in an otherwise arid country. The district also preserves evidence of Inca mining and metallurgy at Viña del Cerro, an establishment in the upper valley where copper ores were processed using furnaces. Its remains show how imperial techniques were brought into the lands of the Diaguita.
simp_chinese: 克约扬布又称“黄土地”，位于智利北部干燥群山之间的科皮亚波河谷。地名与谷地的黄色土壤有关；河水使这片干旱地区得以耕作。当地还保存着印加采矿与冶金的证据：河谷上游的维尼亚德尔塞罗曾用熔炉加工铜矿。遗址显示帝国技术如何传入迪亚吉塔人的土地。

english:
Kells grew around an ancient monastery in the rich country of Meath. Its round tower and carved high crosses recall the community that gave the town its religious importance. The splendid illuminated Book of Kells was kept here for centuries, long after the monastic settlement had become a walled market town near the edge of the English Pale.

The dissolution of the monasteries weakened the old ecclesiastical community. In the 1650s, during the Cromwellian settlement of Ireland, the book left Kells and the town's lands were redistributed. Colonel Richard Stephens received Kells in 1654 and sold his interest to Thomas Taylor, a surveyor who had come to Ireland with William Petty. Taylor's descendants became major landowners in the district, while the tower and crosses continued to mark the much older sacred site.
simp_chinese:
凯尔斯围绕米斯富饶乡间的一座古老修道院发展起来。圆塔和雕刻精美的高十字架，令人想起赋予这里宗教地位的修道社群。华丽的彩饰手抄本《凯尔斯书》曾在此保存数百年；其间，修道聚落发展为靠近英格兰统治区边缘的有墙市镇。

修道院解散削弱了旧有教会社群。1650年代，克伦威尔征服后的土地安置改变了凯尔斯：《凯尔斯书》离开当地，城镇土地也被重新分配。理查德·斯蒂芬斯上校于1654年获得凯尔斯，随后将权益售予测量员托马斯·泰勒；泰勒曾随威廉·佩蒂来到爱尔兰。其后裔成为当地大地主，而圆塔与十字架仍标示着远较他们古老的宗教遗址。

english: Kelt Aiken was an Aónikenk stopping place near the southern shore of the great lake known as O'Higgins or San Martín. Its name contains a word for ice, fitting a landscape of cold waters and glaciers below the southern Andes. The lake reaches into the mountains in long branching arms, while open Patagonian country spreads to the east. Its shores formed part of routes used by Indigenous travellers through this rugged region.
simp_chinese: 凯尔特艾肯是奥尼肯克人在奥希金斯湖或圣马丁湖南岸附近的一处停留地。地名含有表示冰的词，恰与南安第斯山下寒冷湖水和冰川的景观相符。湖泊以狭长支湾伸入群山，东面则展开开阔的巴塔哥尼亚地带。湖岸属于原住民旅人穿越这片崎岖地区所走路线的一部分。

english: Kelta is an Indigenous name associated with the lake later called San Martín or O’Higgins, a deeply branching body of water among the southern Patagonian Andes. Glaciers descend towards its western arms, while rivers connect its eastern side with the steppe. Accounts based on Tehuelche knowledge recorded the name Kelt-Aike for a place reached by ascending the river system. The lake drains westwards through the Pascua River to the Pacific.
simp_chinese: 凯尔塔是与后来称为圣马丁湖或奥希金斯湖有关的原住民名称。这座湖位于巴塔哥尼亚南部安第斯山脉，湖湾曲折分支。冰川下降至西部湖湾，河流则将东侧与草原相连。根据特维尔切人知识形成的记述，凯尔特艾克是沿河流系统上行可抵达的一处地点。湖水经帕斯夸河向西流入太平洋。

english: Kelyuyekyan lies near the middle Kolyma, northeast of the country drained by the Sededema. On the Kolyma, the fortified settlement that became Srednekolymsk was founded in the seventeenth century, during the Russian advance into northeastern Siberia.
simp_chinese: 克柳耶克扬位于科雷马河中游附近，在谢杰杰马河流域的东北方。十七世纪，俄国人向西伯利亚东北部推进，在科雷马河畔建立了一座堡寨，后来发展成中科雷姆斯克。

english:
Kem stood where its river reached the White Sea, linking the Karelian interior with the maritime world of the Pomors. It is recorded in 1450 in connection with Marfa Boretskaya's gift to the Solovetsky Monastery. The settlement and its surrounding lands consequently belonged to a monastic economy whose reach extended across the sea. Fishing, seal hunting, salt boiling and boatbuilding helped sustain the coastal inhabitants.

This shore was also exposed to war. Swedish attacks in the sixteenth century brought destruction and rebuilding, while wooden fortifications protected the settlement; a new wooden fort was erected in 1657. The early eighteenth century left a different monument in the timber Dormition Cathedral, begun in 1711, with its tall tented roofs and carved religious interior. In 1785 Catherine II granted Kem town status as the centre of a new district in Olonets Governorate. A coastal settlement shaped by monastic ownership and sea trades thus acquired a formal place in imperial provincial administration.
simp_chinese:
凯姆位于同名河流注入白海之处，将卡累利阿内陆与波莫尔人的海上世界相连。1450年的记载把这里与玛尔法·博列茨卡娅向索洛韦茨基修道院的赠地联系起来。聚落及周围土地因而纳入跨越海面的修道院经济。捕鱼、猎捕海豹、煮盐和造船，是沿岸居民的重要生计。

白海岸也会受到战争波及。十六世纪瑞典军队的袭击造成破坏，居民重建聚落并以木质防御工事守护它；1657年，这里又修起一座木堡。十八世纪初，1711年开工的木制圣母安息主教座堂留下了另一种面貌，高耸的帐篷形屋顶与内部宗教陈设体现北方木建筑传统。1785年，叶卡捷琳娜二世授予凯姆城市地位，使它成为奥洛涅茨省新设县的治所。这个深受修道院领地制度与海上行业塑造的聚落，由此获得帝国地方行政中的正式位置。

english: The Kema rises on the eastern slopes of the Sikhote-Alin Mountains and flows southeast to the Sea of Japan. Its clear mountain waters descend through a forested valley before reaching Storm Bay near the coast. Heavy rain can raise the river rapidly, while the steep uplands divide its basin from neighbouring rivers. The valley forms a passage from the high watershed to a rugged shore exposed to the sea.
simp_chinese: 克马河发源于锡霍特山脉东坡，向东南流入日本海。清澈山水穿过森林河谷，最终在海岸附近汇入风暴湾。大雨可使河水迅速上涨，陡峭高地则将其流域与邻近河流分开。河谷构成从高山分水岭通向面海崎岖海岸的通道。

english:
Kemah stands on the southern bank of the Karasu, the western Euphrates, beneath a formidable fortress on a rocky height. Known to Armenians as Kamakha, it was an ancient royal burial place and later a frontier stronghold contested by Byzantines and Muslim powers. The river and the cliffs gave the castle strong natural defences along the route through the upper Euphrates valley.

At the end of the fourteenth century Kemah belonged to the lord of Erzincan, Mutahharten. Ottoman Sultan Bayezid seized the fortress in 1401, but Timur recovered it during his campaign against him. The castle subsequently passed among regional rulers before the Ottomans captured it in 1515. Its command of the valley ensured that Kemah remained an important fortified centre under Ottoman rule.
simp_chinese:
凯马赫位于幼发拉底河西支卡拉苏河南岸，一座坚固的堡垒建在岩石高地上。亚美尼亚人称其为卡马哈，这里曾是古代王室的安葬地，后来成为拜占庭与穆斯林势力争夺的边疆要塞。河流和悬崖为城堡提供了天然防御，守护着穿越幼发拉底河上游谷地的道路。

十四世纪末，凯马赫属于埃尔津詹领主穆塔赫哈尔滕。奥斯曼苏丹巴耶济德于1401年夺取要塞，帖木儿在讨伐他的途中又收复了它。城堡随后在地区统治者之间易手，1515年被奥斯曼人攻占。凭借对河谷的控制，凯马赫在奥斯曼统治下仍是一处重要的设防中心。

english: Kembhavi, in the Shorapur country of northern Karnataka, preserves a local connection with the Bahmani sultanate. Its historical remains include tombs associated with that dynasty, which continued to receive Muslim veneration long afterwards. These burial places gave the settlement an enduring place in the religious landscape left by the medieval Deccan sultans.
simp_chinese: 位于卡纳塔克北部绍拉普尔地区的肯巴维，保存着与巴赫曼尼苏丹国相关的地方遗迹。其中包括归于该王朝的墓葬，后世穆斯林仍前往敬奉。这些墓葬使聚落在中世纪德干苏丹留下的宗教景观中保持着长久的位置。

english: Kemijärvi lies on the Kemijoki, where a branching lake spreads among the forests of Lapland. In the sixteenth century both Sámi and people from Kemi came here to fish, while settlers gradually established farms along the bays. A chapel was founded under Kemi, and in 1648 Jakob Lapodius was appointed to serve at Kemijärvi and teach Christianity to the Sámi. A larger church replaced the early building in the 1690s.
simp_chinese: 凯米耶尔维位于凯米河畔，一座多支流的湖泊在拉普兰森林间展开。16世纪，萨米人和凯米居民都来到此地捕鱼，移民也逐渐在湖湾沿岸建立农庄。当地设立凯米教区的附属礼拜堂，1648年雅各布·拉波迪乌斯获任在此服务并向萨米人传教。1690年代，一座较大的教堂取代了早期建筑。

english:
Kemôimenahan was an Abenaki name for the island also known in French as Île aux Prunes, in the Saint Lawrence near Verchères. The Indigenous name means the island of lice.

The island later became part of the Verchères estate. On 3 November 1672, Intendant Jean Talon granted François Jarret de Verchères a riverfront fief with seigneurial and judicial rights. The original grant measured half a league in frontage and one league in depth; it was subsequently enlarged to include Île aux Prunes, Île Longue and additional land inland. Jarret had come to New France with the Carignan-Salières regiment and remained after its recall to France. His estate belonged to the colonial effort to settle former soldiers along the river.
simp_chinese:
凯莫伊梅纳汉是圣劳伦斯河韦尔谢尔附近一座岛屿的阿贝纳基名称，法语称梅子岛。原住民名称意为“虱子岛”。

岛屿后来成为韦尔谢尔领地的一部分。1672年11月3日，行政长官让·塔隆授予弗朗索瓦·雅雷·德韦尔谢尔一块沿河封地，附带领主权及司法权，最初临河宽半里格、纵深一里格。领地随后扩张，加入梅子岛、长岛及更多内陆土地。雅雷随卡里尼昂—萨利耶尔团来到新法兰西，在部队撤回法国后留下，其地产属于殖民当局鼓励退伍军人沿河定居的措施。

english:
Kempendeeyi, usually written Kempendyai in Russian sources, is associated with the salt springs of the Vilyuy country in Sakha. A report of 1640 brought the locality into Russian written records: the Cossack Voin Shakhov obtained a hundred poods of salt there. This was a report of extraction by a Russian newcomer, rather than evidence that the springs had previously been unknown to local people.

The springs later attracted the scientific parties working across Siberia during the Second Kamchatka Expedition. In 1736 Stepan Krasheninnikov and A. Ivanov investigated them. These episodes give the locality a history different from a generic frontier settlement founded only for furs: its distinctive resource was brine and the salt recovered from it. Indigenous information, Cossack activity and imperial scientific inquiry successively brought the same resource into written accounts, tying a place in the northern forest to wider administrative and research networks.
simp_chinese:
肯片迪亚在俄文资料中通常写作Kempendyai，与萨哈维柳伊地区的盐泉密切相关。1640年的记载将此地带入俄国书面记录：哥萨克沃因·沙霍夫在这里取得一百普特食盐。这是俄国来人采盐的记录，不能据此认为当地居民此前不知道盐泉。

此后，第二次堪察加远征中穿行西伯利亚的科研人员也来到盐泉，斯捷潘·克拉舍宁尼科夫和A.伊万诺夫于1736年加以调查。这些事件为当地提供了不同于一般皮毛边疆聚落的历史内容，其独特资源是卤水及由此取得的盐。原住民信息、哥萨克活动和帝国科学调查，先后将同一种资源写入记录，使森林中的具体地点与更广阔的行政和研究网络发生联系。

english:
Kempten lies beside the Iller in the Allgäu, on the site of Roman Cambodunum. A monastery founded in the eighth century became a powerful lordship, while the town by the river gradually secured the status of an imperial city. Salt, linen and metal goods sustained its trade. The city stood beside the abbey's own settlement, but their separate rulers often quarrelled.

During the Peasants' War in 1525, the prince-abbot sold his remaining rights in the imperial city to its citizens. The city embraced the Reformation, while the neighbouring abbey remained Catholic. In the Thirty Years' War Swedish troops destroyed the monastery in 1632; imperial and Bavarian forces then stormed the city. The abbey was rebuilt around Saint Lawrence's church and a princely residence. Bavaria occupied both communities in 1802, secularising the abbey and ending the city's independence; the two towns were formally united in 1818.
simp_chinese:
肯普滕位于阿尔高的伊勒河畔，坐落在罗马城市坎博杜努姆的旧址上。八世纪建立的修道院成为强大的领主，河边城镇则逐渐取得帝国城市地位。盐、亚麻布和金属制品支撑着贸易。城市与修道院自己的聚落毗邻而立，却分别由不同统治者治理，争执不断。

1525年农民战争期间，采邑院长将他在帝国城市剩余的权利卖给市民。城市接受宗教改革，邻近修院则保持天主教信仰。三十年战争中，瑞典军队于1632年摧毁修道院，帝国和巴伐利亚军队随后攻陷城市。修院围绕圣劳伦斯教堂和采邑院长的驻所重建。1802年，巴伐利亚占领两处聚落，将修院世俗化并结束帝国城市的独立；1818年，两城正式合并。

english:
Kenai stood within the Dena’ina homeland around Cook Inlet, where European trading ventures met established Indigenous communities. In 1791 Russian traders established Fort Saint Nicholas at the mouth of the Kenai River. It belonged to a network of Lebedev-Lastochkin Company posts that also included Kasilof, Tyonek and Old Iliamna. The Dena’ina became directly involved in the fur trade while facing violence and intimidation from the traders.

In the summer and autumn of 1797, Dena’ina warriors struck back. They destroyed posts at Tyonek and Old Iliamna and severely damaged the main redoubt at Kenai. Many surviving company employees left for Russia, leaving only scattered traders and missionaries. This resistance sharply limited Russian control, showing that a fortified trading station did not by itself establish secure rule over the surrounding people.
simp_chinese:
基奈位于库克湾周围的德纳伊纳人故土，欧洲贸易企业在这里接触既有的原住民社群。1791年，俄国商人在基奈河口建立圣尼古拉堡，属于列别杰夫—拉斯托奇金公司的据点网络，其他站点包括卡西洛夫、泰奥内克和旧伊利亚姆纳。德纳伊纳人直接参与毛皮贸易，同时遭受商人的暴力与恐吓。

1797年夏秋，德纳伊纳战士发动反击，摧毁泰奥内克和旧伊利亚姆纳的站点，并重创基奈的主要堡垒。许多幸存公司雇员返回俄国，只留下零散商人与传教士。这场抵抗大幅限制了俄国的控制，设防贸易站并未自动带来对周围居民的稳固统治。

english:
The Kenai fjords formed part of the maritime country of the Sugpiaq, also called Alutiiq. Kayaks and larger open skin boats linked its coastal settlements to communities far along the Alaskan shore. Objects recovered from local village sites include coal beads made from material originating on the Alaska Peninsula, evidence of connections extending westward beyond the fjords.

Russian trade goods travelled through these networks before nearby posts were founded. When James Cook reached the coast in 1778, Chugach people already wore imported beads obtained through trade with the Aleutians. By the 1790s and early nineteenth century, iron knives and glass beads appeared alongside traditional slate hunting weapons in Kenai coastal villages. Sea otter pelts drew these communities into the Russian fur trade, while the archaeological record shows continued use of Indigenous tools alongside imported materials.
simp_chinese:
基奈峡湾属于苏格皮亚克人、亦称阿卢提克人的海上家园。皮艇和较大的敞口蒙皮船，将沿海聚落与阿拉斯加海岸远处的社群联系起来。当地村落遗址出土的煤制珠饰，其原料来自阿拉斯加半岛，显示居民的联系向西伸出峡湾之外。

俄国贸易品在附近商站建立以前，便已沿这些网络流通。1778年詹姆斯·库克抵达海岸时，楚加奇人已经佩戴经阿留申群岛贸易获得的进口珠饰。到十八世纪九十年代及十九世纪初，基奈沿海村落中的铁刀、玻璃珠与传统板岩猎具并存。海獭皮使这些社群卷入俄国毛皮贸易；考古遗存同时表明，居民在采用外来材料时仍继续使用本土工具。

english: The Kenamu River, Tshenuamiu-shipu in Innu, flows through the forested country south of Lake Melville and enters the lake from the south. It has long been an important salmon-fishing river for the Innu. Trails and portages along the river also led inland towards caribou-hunting grounds around the Little Drunken River. The river forms part of Nitassinan, where families travelled between the lake shore and the wooded interior to fish and hunt.
simp_chinese: 凯纳穆河在因努语中称为切努阿米乌希普，流经梅尔维尔湖南方的森林，从南岸注入湖中。它长久以来是因努人重要的鲑鱼渔场。沿河的小径和搬舟路线还通向内陆，抵达小醉河附近的北美驯鹿猎场。这条河属于因努人的家园尼塔西南，家庭往返于湖岸与森林腹地之间，捕鱼和狩猎。

english: Kenda was a wooded estate in the hills north of the Chhattisgarh plain, beside the country of Lapha. Its sal forests yielded lac, a valuable resin collected for use in dyes and other products. A route from the plain passed through Kenda and Pendra toward Sohagpur and Rewa; across much of the hills it was little more than a track through forest. Local tradition connects the chiefs of Kenda with the family that held the neighbouring estate of Pendra.
simp_chinese: 肯达是恰蒂斯加尔平原以北山区的一处林地领地，毗邻拉法地区。它的娑罗树林出产紫胶，这种珍贵树脂可用于染料及其他制品。从平原出发的一条道路经过肯达和彭德拉，通向索哈格布尔与雷瓦；穿越山地的大部分路段只是林间小径。当地传统将肯达的首领与掌管邻近彭德拉领地的家族联系起来。

english: Kendari Bay is a long, sheltered inlet on the southeastern peninsula of Sulawesi, with a narrow entrance from the sea. Inland lay the Tolaki kingdom of Konawe, whose lands produced forest goods and rice. The bay's coastal communities included Bugis and Sama-Bajau seafarers, as well as people connected with Ternate and Seram.
simp_chinese: 肯达里湾位于苏拉威西东南半岛，是入口狭窄、较为隐蔽的狭长海湾。内陆是托拉基人的科纳韦王国，出产林产品与稻米。沿湾社群包括布吉人与萨马—巴瑶航海者，也有与特尔纳特和塞兰相联系的居民。

english: Kendawangan lies on the southwestern coast of Borneo, where rivers reach the sea through a landscape of wetlands and forest. The Kendawangan estuary opens onto broad mudflats, while parts of the coast rise into hills and steep cliffs. River channels connect the shore with the interior of the island; along the coast, tidal waters meet the fresh water flowing down from inland. Nearby rivers include the Air Hitam Kecil and Air Hitam Besar.
simp_chinese: 肯达旺岸位于婆罗洲西南岸，河流穿过湿地与森林，在此汇入大海。肯达旺岸河口前方分布广阔泥滩，部分海岸则升为丘陵与陡峭悬崖。河道把海岸与岛屿内陆相连，潮水在岸边与内陆流下的淡水相遇。附近河流还包括小黑水河与大黑水河。

english: Kenderli-Kayasan is a plateau in the dry country east of the Caspian Sea, associated with the Mangyshlak region. Its exposed upland lies among the plains and escarpments of the wider Ustyurt country. Sparse rainfall and the lack of permanent surface streams give much of this landscape its austere character, while the Caspian shore lies to the west.
simp_chinese: 肯迭里-卡亚桑是里海以东干旱地带的一片高原，与曼格什拉克地区相连。开阔的高地位于乌斯秋尔特广大地区的平原和陡崖之间。降雨稀少，又缺少常年地表河流，使这里的大部分景观显得荒凉；里海海岸则在西方。

english: Off the southwestern coast of Sumatra, the Indian Ocean surrounds the island of Enggano and the smaller islands near it. Enggano lies well offshore from Bengkulu, separated from the mainland by open water. Forested land and mangrove shores meet the tropical sea, while waves approach from the wide ocean to the west. The island forms part of a scattered chain off Sumatra’s western coast.
simp_chinese: 苏门答腊西南海岸之外，印度洋环绕恩加诺岛及附近小岛。恩加诺远离明古鲁海岸，与苏门答腊本岛之间隔着开阔水面。森林与红树林海岸临近热带海洋，西方广阔洋面上的波浪不断抵岸。这座岛属于苏门答腊西岸外散布的岛链。

english: Tengdey lies near the headwaters of the Byosyuke, north of the Arctic Circle. The river begins where the Meychan and Sakhandya meet on the flank of the Orulgan Range, then bends northwest toward the Lena. Its course skirts the northern edge of the Dzhardzhan Range.
simp_chinese: 滕德伊位于北极圈以北，靠近别休克河的源头。梅伊昌河与萨汉佳河在奥鲁尔干山脉山坡上汇合，形成别休克河；河水随后向西北流，沿贾尔詹山脉北缘流向勒拿河。

english: Kengkham lies on the Nam Pang in the Shan country west of the Salween. The river flows south through a valley enclosed by mountain ridges before joining the greater river. In 1811 Kengkham became the centre of a small Shan state tributary to the Burmese Konbaung dynasty. Its ruler held the title of myoza, governing the valley among the neighbouring principalities of the plateau.
simp_chinese: 景康位于萨尔温江以西掸地的南邦河畔。河流沿群山环绕的谷地向南流去，最终汇入大江。1811年，景康成为一个向缅甸贡榜王朝朝贡的小型掸邦政体的中心。当地统治者使用缪萨的称号，在高原上邻近诸邦之间治理这片河谷。

english:
Keng Tawng was a Shan river town watered by the Nam Teng, in the country associated with Mongnai. Its position mattered to the movement of armies and to the defense of the Salween frontier. Local chiefs held towns and village tracts under the Burmese crown, and their rank could reflect the services they provided to troops passing through their territories.

A royal order of 13 January 1812 rewarded Keng Tawng's chief, Nga Hkun Byu. It praised his reception of marching soldiers and his care for fourteen outposts along the Salween, granting him the standing of a senior sawbwa and appropriate insignia. The same order recalled a remarkable gift: a lance believed to possess magical powers. Its reported discovery had already produced a dispute with Mongnai over the place where it was found. In October 1811 the king ordered the lance sent to court together with drawings of its stone setting. Military obligations, contested jurisdiction and the presentation of a sacred object thus all entered Keng Tawng's relationship with the royal capital.
simp_chinese:
景唐是南腾河滋养的掸族河滨城镇，位于与孟乃相联系的地区。它的位置关系到军队过境及萨尔温江边防。当地首领在缅王属下掌管城镇和村寨，其地位也与为过境军队提供的服务有关。

1812年1月13日的一道王令奖赏景唐首领Nga Hkun Byu，称赞他妥善接待行军部队、维护萨尔温江沿岸十四处前哨，授予高级土司的地位与相应仪仗。王令同时提及一件特殊贡物：据称具有神力的长矛。这件器物的发现地点曾引起景唐与孟乃的管辖争议。早在1811年10月，缅王便命人将长矛送往朝廷，并绘图呈报其嵌置的石座。军役、边界争执与神圣器物的进献，因此共同进入景唐同王都往来的记载之中。

english:
Kengtung was the seat of a Tai Khün principality in the eastern Shan highlands. Its traditions linked the ruling house with Chiang Mai and the dynasty of Mangrai, giving the basin connections to the wider world of Lan Na. Local rulers governed from their own court while negotiating the demands of larger neighbors, and the town's importance extended beyond its surrounding rice land.

Military service made those connections costly. Kengtung's forces joined Bayinnaung's campaigns against Ayutthaya in the sixteenth century, and Shan chronicles place a large invading army's departure from Kengtung in 1764 during renewed Burmese warfare with Siam. Later, the direction of violence reversed. Chiang Mai's campaigns carried Tai Khün captives south to repopulate its own country, while Kengtung underwent occupation and disruption in the early nineteenth century. Burmese assistance restored the ruling dynasty in 1814. The movement of soldiers and captive families changed the human geography on both sides of the mountains. Kengtung's history was shaped by the struggle to retain people, cultivation and local dynastic authority within this contested highland corridor.
simp_chinese:
景栋是掸邦东部高地一座傣痕人政权的中心。地方传统将统治家族同清迈及孟莱王朝联系起来，使盆地与兰纳世界保持渊源。当地首领拥有自己的宫廷，又须同更强大的邻国周旋，城镇的影响因而越出周围稻田的范围。

军役使这些联系付出沉重代价。十六世纪，景栋部队参与莽应龙进攻阿瑜陀耶的战争；掸族史书又记载，1764年缅暹再战时，大批进攻军队从景栋出发。后来战争方向逆转，清迈的征伐将傣痕俘虏带往南方，用以补充当地人口，景栋在十九世纪初经历占领与动荡，1814年在缅方援助下恢复原统治家族。士兵和被迁家庭的移动改变了山岭两侧的人口分布。维持居民、耕地与地方王朝的权威，始终是这条高地走廊上的重要争夺。

english: Kenhionatatie lies near the Grand River, in the country once inhabited by the Attawandaron. After the American Revolutionary War, Haudenosaunee families led by Joseph Brant settled along the river. In 1784 the Haldimand Proclamation promised Mohawks and other Six Nations people land extending six miles on each side of the Grand from Lake Erie to its source.
simp_chinese: 肯希奥纳塔蒂位于大河附近，这片地区曾是阿塔万达龙人的家园。美国独立战争后，约瑟夫·布兰特率领豪德诺索尼家庭沿河定居。1784年的《哈尔迪曼德公告》向莫霍克及其他六族人民许诺大河两岸各六英里的土地，范围从伊利湖延伸到河源。

english: Kèňiergyn stands on the eastern shore of the Gulf of the Cross, south of the mountains at the head of the bay. The gulf cuts deeply into the Chukchi Peninsula from the Bering Sea, with tundra and hills rising around its shores. Walruses, seals and whales inhabit these waters, while reindeer graze inland; coastal and inland communities drew on the different resources of this northern country.
simp_chinese: 克涅尔根位于十字湾东岸、湾顶群山以南。海湾从白令海深入楚科奇半岛，沿岸高耸着苔原和丘陵。海象、海豹与鲸栖息于湾中水域，驯鹿在内陆草地放牧；沿海和内陆社群依靠这片北方土地的不同资源维持生计。

english: The Kenkeme rises at the northeastern edge of the Lena Plateau, where the Yagas-Yyabyt and Yolyong-Yuryage meet. It flows across central Yakutia to join the Lena from the left, its lower course entering the broad central Yakutian lowland. Forest and streams surround the river, which can become very shallow in summer. Like other waterways in this region, it lies beneath winter ice for months.
simp_chinese: 肯克梅河发源于勒拿高原东北缘，由亚加斯—厄亚贝特河与约隆—尤里亚格河汇合而成。它穿过雅库特中部，从左岸注入勒拿河，下游进入宽广的雅库特中部低地。森林与溪流环绕河道，夏季河水可能变得很浅；如同本地区其他水道，冬季它在冰层下沉睡数月。

english:
Kenmure Castle rose on a knoll near the head of Loch Ken in Galloway. The Gordons of Lochinvar built a courtyard house there during the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries. Its western range combined domestic rooms with gunloops, while vaulted ground-floor stores and an octagonal stair tower gave practical form to a fortified aristocratic residence.

The castle was rebuilt after a siege in 1568 and faced another siege by Cromwell's forces in 1650. These episodes left a structure repeatedly altered and incorporating reused stonework. A view made in 1790 showed two tall corner towers standing roofless, although other parts continued to change. Kenmure's architecture thus recorded both the demands of defence and the changing requirements of its owners. Its courtyard, storage spaces and decorated entrance placed household life and family display within a building that also had to withstand armed conflict.
simp_chinese:
肯缪尔城堡位于加洛韦肯湖顶端附近的山丘上。洛钦瓦尔的戈登家族于十六、十七世纪在此修建庭院式宅邸。西翼将居室与射击孔结合，底层拱顶储藏室及八角楼梯塔，共同构成具备防御能力的贵族住宅。

城堡在1568年围攻后重建，1650年又遭克伦威尔军队围攻，留下反复改造、重新利用旧石料的建筑。1790年的图像显示两座高大角塔已失去屋顶，其他部分则继续变化。城堡形态因此记录了防御需要和主人生活要求的调整。庭院、储藏空间与装饰入口，将家族日常生活和身份展示安置于一座还必须应对武装冲突的建筑中。

english: Kennebango lies among the wooded lakes and mountains of western Maine. Kennebago Lake drains by a short outlet into the river of the same name, whose waters continue south towards the Rangeley lakes. Streams and lakes break up the forested uplands, forming a connected watershed in the headwaters of the Androscoggin. The long winters and rugged terrain distinguish this northern country from the lower valleys nearer the coast.
simp_chinese: 肯尼班戈位于缅因西部森林覆盖的山地与湖泊之间。肯尼巴戈湖通过一条短水道流入同名河流，河水继续向南流往兰杰利湖群。溪流和湖泊分布在林地高原上，组成安德罗斯科金河上游彼此相连的流域。漫长冬季与崎岖地形，使这片北方山地不同于更靠近海岸的低地河谷。

english:
In September 1775 Benedict Arnold's expedition entered the Kennebec valley on its way to attack Quebec. The river formed part of established Wabanaki travel corridors connecting the coast to the interior. Arnold's troops began their inland journey from Reuben Colburn's shipyard at present-day Pittston, then passed Fort Western and moved towards Fort Halifax, beyond which colonial settlements gave way to a much harder route.

The expedition followed the Kennebec and Dead River system through rapids, swamps and difficult portages. An inaccurate map encouraged expectations of a journey lasting about three weeks; it took more than twice that long. Capsized boats, floods, snow, illness and starvation reduced the force before it reached Canada. The march exposed the distance between recognising a strategic river corridor and possessing the equipment, supplies and knowledge needed to move an army through it.
simp_chinese:
1775年9月，本尼迪克特·阿诺德率远征队进入肯纳贝克河谷，准备进攻魁北克。这条河属于瓦班纳基人连接海岸与内陆的既有通道。部队从今皮茨顿的鲁本·科尔本造船场启程深入内陆，经过西部堡，再向哈利法克斯堡推进；此后殖民聚落渐少，前路更加艰难。
